message.title: Documents
message.body: These documents support your $487.00 claim payment from Horizon Inc. Open each one, read it through and select Next to mark it as Done.

documents.name: Property Inspection Report
documents.description: Independent adjuster’s assessment of the claim, including damage findings and the recommended settlement figure for your review.

documents.name: Repair Cost Estimate
documents.description: Supporting documentation and itemised cost breakdown referenced in the primary adjuster report. Please confirm the figures match your records.

documents.name: Settlement Agreement
documents.description: Final summary and payment authorisation terms. By accepting, you confirm you’ve reviewed the disbursement details.
